title: publish_service inputSchema
description: Argument shape for the lifecycle service-publish tool (advertised name honua_publish_service). Publishes a table from a registered secure connection as a layer on a target service via the canonical service.publish operation. x-honua-reference-shape: tracks the reference implementation.

connectionId.description: Secure-connection identifier whose table is published. Required: the canonical service.publish operation resolves the target database connection from it.

schema.description: Source schema containing the table to publish.

table.description: Source table to publish as a layer.

layerName.description: Display name for the published layer.

serviceName.description: Target service name. Defaults to the canonical default service when omitted.

geometryColumn.description: Geometry column to publish when the table has more than one.

geometryType.description: Geometry type override (for example Point, Polygon) when it cannot be inferred.

srid.description: Spatial reference identifier for the published layer.

primaryKey.description: Primary key column when the table has no detectable key.

fields.description: Subset of attribute columns to publish. All columns are published when omitted.
